answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using proof of space-time. Agents must commit cryptographic tables onto ferrous storage platters, which a lotus validation network audits using timed echo queries. This ensures records reside on local physical drives, forcing an attacker to dedicate scarce non-volatile disk capacity per identity. However, large datacenters with bulk hardware discounts can amass storage and identities at much lower marginal costs than ordinary agents.
